subject.title: feat(signal): add setup wizard container flow

question: Should OpenClaw accept this Signal setup direction now, including setupApplied rollback, receive-readiness-gated existing-server setup, account-scoped apiMode, and no OpenClaw-managed Signal Docker container path?
rationale: The patch appears coherent, but it changes user-facing setup/config behavior and Signal receive transport selection; automation cannot decide the permanent product and upgrade contract for existing Signal operators.

options.title: Accept Current Direction
options.body: Land after exact-head merge readiness if maintainers accept plugin-owned Signal setup, account-scoped apiMode, and the documented no-managed-Docker setup path.

options.title: Require Live Signal Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal/log proof of native signal-cli setup and existing-server setup with receive readiness before merge.

options.title: Split The Risk
options.body: Separate the generic setupApplied core contract from the Signal wizard if maintainers want smaller independently reviewable changes.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Direction
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head merge readiness if maintainers accept plugin-owned Signal setup, account-scoped apiMode, and the documented no-managed-Docker setup path.
